messages:
maria: quick heads up — infra is proposing a small rename for the internal routing header to standardize with other services. asking for feedback before we ship anything.

ahmed: what's the exact change?

maria: current header: `X-Redwood-Route` -> proposed: `X-RW-Route`

sasha: why the rename? seems risky for SDKs.

maria: goal is shorter, avoids length limits in some proxies, and aligns with new policy engine. also plan to use the same header for both route hint + affinity token.

ryan: that's a breaking surface for clients that read/write the header. are we planning to support both names for a transition?

maria: yes, suggestion is dual-read in runtime for 6 weeks then deprecate the old name. but SDKs would need to be updated to emit the new header for new clients.

chris: dual-read in server runtime is fine, but telemetry/quotas rely on header value canonicalization. If both exist with different values we could double-count. we need a canonicalization rule documented.

ahmed: +1 on canonicalization. propose: precedence = `X-RW-Route` then fallback to `X-Redwood-Route`. If both present and mismatch, log a `route_header_conflict` telemetry event and pick `X-RW-Route`.

sasha: telemetry event is good. devex/console will need a dashboard tile for conflicts and % of clients still sending old header. otherwise customers will be confused by quota attribution shifts.

maria: noted — console team, can we add a small gauge: fraction_old_header = count(old_only)/count(total_requests) over 1h?

devex-bot: created ticket INF-4921 for console metric + alert.

ci-bot: quick note — SDK test suites flagged header name in multiple places: python/ts/go.

ryan: on SDK side, we have two options: 1) ship a non-breaking patch that sends both headers (duplicate) for a migration window; 2) bump major and change behaviour. Option 1 seems safest but some proxies might drop duplicate headers or treat them as array.

chris: proxies are messy. duplicating can lead to `X` being `val1,val2` or only first. I'd avoid sending both. better: send new header and add a `X-RW-Route-Compat: redwood` hint? feels hacky.

nahmed: alternative: SDKs send only new header but include an explicit `X-RW-Route-Version: 1` and we run server-side dual-read for migration. that'll avoid duplicates and still let us measure adopters via presence of the version header.

sasha: that works. telemetry: emit `route_header_version` dimension (values: `legacy`, `v1`, `missing`) so console can break down traffic.

maria: agree. plan: SDKs update to emit `X-RW-Route` + `X-RW-Route-Version: v1`. runtime will read `X-RW-Route` first, fallback to `X-Redwood-Route`. Telemetry event `route_header_conflict` if both present and different. Metric `route_header_version` on requests. Deprecate old header in 8 weeks.

ryan: timeline ok. for SDK releases: python -> patch release in 2 weeks (no major bump), node -> patch, go -> patch. we should include opt-in flag in SDK configs so customers can hold off: `routeHeaderVersion: 'legacy' | 'v1' | 'auto'` with default `auto` (emit v1 + version header).

chris: make sure default `auto` is clearly documented as opt-into new header. some enterprise customers might want to toggle via env var.

maria: docs task added. also, we need rollout UX in console: show per-tenant adoption and allow toggling a gateway-level compatibility mode for accounts that can't upgrade yet.

sasha: console UX: add a small banner on model routes page with adoption % and a one-click enable compatibility mode that rewrites incoming `X-RW-Route` to `X-Redwood-Route` for legacy backends. This helps customers that host their own proxies.

devex-bot: added console mockup request to DESIGN-230.

ahmed: tests: create e2e test matrix for combinations: only-old, only-new, both-same, both-different, missing. Verify quota attribution, KV cache lookup, and telemetry emission.

ci-bot: flagging broken tests: `sdk-header-e2e` currently fails on node and go due to header parsing differences.

ryan: I'll queue a patch to unify header parsing in SDK common code (shared lib). small API change: `clientOpts.routingHeaderVersion` default `auto`. patch will include tests.

chris: release notes draft (short): "SDKs: add opt-in new routing header `X-RW-Route` + `X-RW-Route-Version` for migration to new runtime policy. Runtime will dual-read for 8 weeks. See docs for migration steps."

maria: can devex prepare a short migration playbook for customers and support? include sample curl + env var snippets.

sasha: sample snippets: `curl -H "X-RW-Route: project:foo" -H "X-RW-Route-Version: v1" ...` and env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_HEADER=auto`. Keep it under 6 steps.

ryan: note: this is NOT changing public auth or rate-limit headers. it's internal routing only. call it out in release notes to avoid panic.

maria: thanks all. I'll consolidate and send a follow-up with timeline and list of ticket IDs. ping me if you want to be on the migration runbook. :thumbsup:

chris: thanks — will sync with enterprise CS to schedule a heads-up email to affected customers.

sasha: +1, we should also add a telemetry alert if adoption stalls below 20% after week 4.

maria: added alert to INF-4921. closing out here for now — will post updates.

devex-bot: thread archived by maria at 3234567925
